phases.caption: Everyone has one job
phases.say: Crossing and finishing, and everybody has one job. The server delivers from the right, the near-post runner attacks the front of the six-yard box and the far-post runner stays late behind him. Played in the attacking third with a keeper and one marker, and a ball to each server.

phases.caption: Near post goes first
phases.say: The near-post runner goes first and drags the marker with him. The far man does the opposite — he waits, because the space he wants is the one the marker is leaving.

phases.caption: In front of the keeper
phases.say: The server puts it in front of the keeper and behind the defender. That strip of grass is where a cross is unsaveable and undefendable at the same time.

phases.caption: Far post finishes
phases.say: Nine gets a touch on it and the far-post runner arrives behind him to finish. Nine never had to score: his job was to take the marker out of the way.

phases.caption:
Coaching points
- Cross in front of the keeper
- Near post goes first
- Far post stays late
phases.say: Coaching points. Cross in front of the keeper, the near post run goes first, and the far post run stays late.
